'''Hedrett Shipping and Investments''' was a company that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Fricasseed Nerf]]'' was contracted to work for Hedrett Shipping and Investments. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ship was damaged because of faulty data supplied by the [[Comet Broom Service]], so Hedrett Shipping and Investments hired the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to investigate the incident.

A short time afterward, the heroes prevented a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] from crashing into the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. A conference was held in the [[Forard]] [[Civic Center (Forard)|Civic Center]] to discuss who had sent the comet and the [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] of Hedrett Shipping and Investments attended the meeting.
